provenance.encodes: Docket-number shapes courts use in captions and citations (Bluebook R. 10.8.1); a heuristic for shapes the docket rule does not name
provenance.how_to_verify: Not a citation rule: compare each hit with the court's docket-number format; a common shape belongs in rules/docket/.

positive.text: The petition, Index No. 654321/2019, was filed in Supreme Court.
Plaintiff filed Civil Action No. 3:19cv567 in Richmond.
It was Adv. Pro. No. 20-50123 in the bankruptcy court.

negative: The case number was never assigned.
In that case, no appeal was taken.
Docket entries are listed by date.
Appeal No. was left blank on the form.
Case No. 5 was set for trial.

note: Catch-all layer: docket numbers the us.docket.number rule already matches (No. 1:20-cv-01234, No. 21-1234) never reach it.
